lines.text: Peter and John go up to the temple at the ninth hour, and a lame man at the gate called Beautiful asks them for money.
Peter tells the lame man to walk in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, and he goes into the Pool of Siloam leaping.
The people recognize the man as the beggar and run to Peter and John in David's Colonnade.
Peter says the people rejected Jesus before Pilate, asked for a murderer to be released, and killed the Author of life, but God raised Him.
Peter says Moses foretold a prophet like him, and God sent His Servant first to the crowd to bless them.
